---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  as_tibble() |>
  summarize(
    career_hr = sum(HR),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .by = playerID
  ) |>
  slice_max(career_hr, n = 15) |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |> # attach names from the People table
  mutate(
    player = fct_reorder(paste(nameFirst, nameLast), career_hr), # put top leader at the top of y-axis
    steroid_era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Active (1994–2009)",
      "Other eras"
    ) # check whether career overlapped 1994 to 2009
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = career_hr, y = player, fill = steroid_era)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Active (1994–2009)" = "firebrick", "Other eras" = "steelblue")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "MLB All-Time Career Home Run Leaders",
    subtitle = "Top 15 sluggers, colored by whether their career overlapped the Steroid Era (1994–2009)",
    x = "Career Home Runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Steroid Era",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  as_tibble() |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  filter(nameFirst == "Barry", nameLast == "Bonds") |> # keep only Barry Bonds's seasons
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = HR)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") + # draw one bar per season
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds's Home Runs by Season (1986–2007)",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
